recognize_zh: 高倍可見大量大型異型細胞，核偏心、呈腎形或凹陷，核仁明顯，細胞質豐富且空泡化，並散在嗜中性球、嗜酸性球與凋亡碎片，是ALCL大型多形性腫瘤細胞的典型表現。
features: Large atypical cells with abundant vacuolated amphophilic cytoplasm
Eccentric, reniform to indented nuclei with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli (hallmark-like cells)
Marked nuclear pleomorphism, including bizarre and multilobated forms
Admixed neutrophils, eosinophils and apoptotic debris
describe_en: High-power H&E shows a diffuse proliferation of large pleomorphic cells with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm and eccentric, kidney-shaped to indented nuclei containing vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, consistent with hallmark cells. Neutrophils, eosinophils and apoptotic debris are interspersed. Findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma; ALK immunostain is required to separate ALK-positive from ALK-negative subtypes.

ddx.vs: Distinguished only by ALK immunoreactivity; morphology is indistinguishable in the common pattern.
HRS cells are CD15+ and weakly PAX5+ with loss of T-cell and cytotoxic markers, whereas ALCL is PAX5-negative and frequently expresses granzyme B/perforin/TIA1.
Histiocytic sarcoma cells are CD163/CD68/PU.1-positive and CD30/T-cell-marker negative.
